site.title: React Best Practices
site.subtitle: 52 rules for optimizing React application performance
site.description: A comprehensive guide to React performance optimization patterns and best practices

async.title: Eliminating Waterfalls
async.description: Waterfalls are the #1 performance killer. Each sequential await adds full network latency. Eliminating them yields the largest gains.

bundle.title: Bundle Size Optimization
bundle.description: Reducing initial bundle size improves Time to Interactive and Largest Contentful Paint.

server.title: Server-Side Performance
server.description: Optimizing server-side rendering and data fetching eliminates server-side waterfalls and reduces response times.

client.title: Client-Side Data Fetching
client.description: Automatic deduplication and efficient data fetching patterns reduce redundant network requests.

rerender.title: Re-render Optimization
rerender.description: Reducing unnecessary re-renders minimizes wasted computation and improves UI responsiveness.

rendering.title: Rendering Performance
rendering.description: Optimizing the rendering process reduces the work the browser needs to do.

js.title: JavaScript Performance
js.description: Micro-optimizations for hot paths can add up to meaningful improvements.

advanced.title: Advanced Patterns
advanced.description: Advanced patterns for specific cases that require careful implementation.

async-parallel.description: When async operations have no interdependencies, execute them concurrently using Promise.all().

async-dependencies.description: For operations with partial dependencies, use better-all to maximize parallelism.

async-api-routes.description: In API routes and Server Actions, start independent operations immediately, even if you don't await them yet.

async-suspense-boundaries.description: Use Suspense boundaries to show wrapper UI faster while data loads.

async-defer-await.description: Move await operations into the branches where they're actually used to avoid blocking code paths that don't need them.

bundle-barrel-imports.description: Import directly from source files instead of barrel files to avoid loading thousands of unused modules.

bundle-dynamic-imports.description: Use next/dynamic to lazy-load large components not needed on initial render.

bundle-conditional.description: Load large data or modules only when a feature is activated.

bundle-defer-third-party.description: Analytics, logging, and error tracking don't block user interaction. Load them after hydration.

bundle-preload.description: Preload heavy bundles before they're needed to reduce perceived latency.

server-auth-actions.description: Server Actions are exposed as public endpoints. Always verify authentication and authorization inside each Server Action.

server-parallel-fetching.description: React Server Components execute sequentially within a tree. Restructure with composition to parallelize data fetching.

server-serialization.description: The React Server/Client boundary serializes all object properties. Only pass fields that the client actually uses.

server-cache-lru.description: React.cache() only works within one request. For data shared across sequential requests, use an LRU cache.

server-cache-react.description: Use React.cache() for server-side request deduplication. Authentication and database queries benefit most.

server-after-nonblocking.description: Use Next.js's after() to schedule work that should execute after a response is sent.

server-dedup-props.description: RSC→client serialization deduplicates by object reference, not value. Do transformations in client, not server.

client-swr-dedup.description: SWR enables request deduplication, caching, and revalidation across component instances.

client-localstorage-schema.description: Add version prefix to keys and store only needed fields. Prevents schema conflicts and accidental storage of sensitive data.

client-passive-event-listeners.description: Add { passive: true } to touch and wheel event listeners to enable immediate scrolling.

client-event-listeners.description: Use useSWRSubscription() to share global event listeners across component instances.

rerender-functional-setstate.description: When updating state based on the current state value, use the functional update form of setState.

rerender-lazy-state-init.description: Pass a function to useState for expensive initial values. Without the function form, the initializer runs on every render.

rerender-memo.description: Extract expensive work into memoized components to enable early returns before computation.

rerender-memo-with-default-value.description: Extract default non-primitive parameter values to constants to preserve memoization.

rerender-derived-state.description: Subscribe to derived boolean state instead of continuous values to reduce re-render frequency.

rerender-defer-reads.description: Don't subscribe to dynamic state (searchParams, localStorage) if you only read it inside callbacks.

rerender-transitions.description: Mark frequent, non-urgent state updates as transitions to maintain UI responsiveness.

rerender-dependencies.description: Specify primitive dependencies instead of objects to minimize effect re-runs.

rerender-simple-expression-in-memo.description: When an expression is simple and has a primitive result type, do not wrap it in useMemo.

rendering-content-visibility.description: Apply content-visibility: auto to defer off-screen rendering.

rendering-hydration-no-flicker.description: Inject a synchronous script that updates the DOM before React hydrates to avoid flickering.

rendering-activity.description: Use React's Activity component to preserve state/DOM for expensive components that frequently toggle visibility.

rendering-hoist-jsx.description: Extract static JSX outside components to avoid re-creation.

rendering-conditional-render.description: Use explicit ternary operators instead of && for conditional rendering when the condition can be 0 or NaN.

rendering-animate-svg-wrapper.description: Wrap SVG in a div and animate the wrapper instead for hardware acceleration.

rendering-svg-precision.description: Reduce SVG coordinate precision to decrease file size.

js-length-check-first.description: When comparing arrays with expensive operations, check lengths first.

js-tosorted-immutable.description: .sort() mutates the array in place. Use .toSorted() to create a new sorted array without mutation.

js-batch-dom-css.description: Avoid interleaving style writes with layout reads to prevent forced synchronous layouts.

js-cache-function-results.description: Use a module-level Map to cache function results when the same function is called repeatedly.

js-index-maps.description: Multiple .find() calls by the same key should use a Map for O(1) lookups.

js-set-map-lookups.description: Convert arrays to Set/Map for repeated membership checks.

js-combine-iterations.description: Multiple .filter() or .map() calls iterate the array multiple times. Combine into one loop.

js-early-exit.description: Return early when result is determined to skip unnecessary processing.

js-hoist-regexp.description: Don't create RegExp inside render. Hoist to module scope or memoize with useMemo().

js-cache-property-access.description: Cache object property lookups in hot paths.

js-cache-storage.description: localStorage, sessionStorage, and document.cookie are synchronous and expensive. Cache reads in memory.

js-min-max-loop.description: Finding the smallest or largest element only requires a single pass through the array. Sorting is wasteful.

advanced-event-handler-refs.description: Store callbacks in refs when used in effects that shouldn't re-subscribe on callback changes.

advanced-use-latest.description: Access latest values in callbacks without adding them to dependency arrays using useEffectEvent.
